scientific.integrity: The proof is an exact Chern-root calculation for the regular zero locus of two symmetric-square tautological sections on Gr(2,7), followed by exact Grassmannian coefficient extraction. A dependency-free script replays only the final coefficient arithmetic.
limitations: The claim is restricted to the fourfold of lines on a smooth intersection of two quadrics in projective six-space.
Only one explicit negative effective surface class is needed and computed; the full effective surface cone is not determined.
No claim is made about weak 2-Fano behavior of other Fano schemes of linear spaces on intersections of two quadrics.

title: The fourfold of lines on two quadrics in \(\mathbf P^6\) is not weakly \(2\)-Fano
